# requires: wire
#
# The artifact was replaced while a prefix of the old one sat on disk. The
# server's range is honest and belongs to a file the prefix never came from, so
# the splice has exactly the right length and the wrong contents, and no
# transport error and no length check can see it.
#
# The only thing that can is If-Range: send the version the prefix came from and
# the server answers 206 for the same file and 200 -- the whole new one -- for a
# different one. An implementation that does not send it cannot be told from one
# that does until the day a server changes a file.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:etag
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40 stale
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40,"validators":{"etag":"\"v1\""}}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-V1]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 6: cp={"verified_prefix":64,"validators":{"etag":"\"v2\""}} [DL-V2]
# expect 7: ok -
